lines: Last night, twenty-three sweetheart cards came back from the enemy trenches.
One of them was Wings, the legendary card. Felix Dougc, a Hegemony machine gunner, found it on the raid.
Three hundred and twenty-two raiders went over in the rain. One hundred and thirty-one enemies died in their own trenches.
It was the deadliest day of the war. Three hundred and fifty-eight fell.
Four hundred and fifty lie wounded in the mud. The medics can reach only one in three.
Seventy-four new soldiers came up yesterday. Two thousand two hundred and eighty-nine now hold the front.
Hospital: a new dugout, surgeons and stretchers. Fewer of your wounded will die.
Tank: a Behemoth for the Hegemony, a Tortoise for the Concord. Your shooters hit harder for four days. But a tank draws fire.
Save your wounded, or win the fight? Comment HOSPITAL or TANK. Each side votes for itself.
